_comment: Batch 02 — five NEW cells on the hook × moment × format grid (no batch-01 repeats), exploratory (no perf.json verdicts exist yet). Every clip is a NATIVE 9:16 capture from tools/capture-vertical.mjs (marketing/vertical/*.mp4, 1080x1920, the game laid out by itself between the hook band and the bottom 25%, the engine's own generated audio in the track) — placed full-frame by tiktok-batch.mjs, no crop, no letterbox. Cut points sit between moves (from the capture's own tap/exit sound onsets); text-bearing shots hold ≥ 0.35 s/word (min 2 s) and no cut lands on legible text. Sub-lines and countdown digits live in the hook band, never over the game. Narration = cached ElevenLabs lines only (voice Adam). Phase A CTA.
_verdicts: none — batch-01 has no 72-h numbers yet (perf.json all null); this batch widens the grid rather than mutating winners.
